redesigned_document.plain_text:
We're here to help you with your notice
Dear Valued Customer,
Thank you for your continued partnership with us. We want to make this process as smooth, transparent, and stress-free as possible for you. Mandatory Notice To help us keep your account running smoothly, please submit your Audited Balance Sheet by 15 December 2026. To avoid any service interruption or immediate covenant default.

Need help?
We understand that gathering documents or meeting requirements can sometimes take extra coordination. Please reach out to us early if you have questions or need assistance — we are here to support you.

Important Obligations & Legal Disclosures
Mandatory Notice You are hereby required to submit your Audited Balance Sheet by 15 December 2026. Failure to comply will result in immediate covenant default.

Warm regards, Customer Support Team
